name: McCurry's Strawberry Farm
description: In 735 Wise Road, NC, McCurry's Strawberry Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
